summary: Server one-frame request that an entity is being thrown (seen alive in item-throw and shove-throw). Drained by esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50), which copies +0xC, +0x10 and +0x18 into eoc::thrown::IsThrownComponent (layouts\alive\eoc.thrown.IsThrownComponent.json: float, byte, EntityHandle) and uses +0..+0xC in the rotation it writes to the frame data; also read by improvised_weapon::PickUpSystem and invisibility::ChangesSystem::ProcessItemAnimationStateChanges.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E8F670 zeroes +0..+0xF. EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 lines 523-533 read floats +0,+4,+8 together with +0xC and compose them like a quaternion (x,y,z,w) with the computed spin rotation. Live: (4, -1.3, 1), (17.6, -1.36, 5) ... - not normalised, so kept as vec3.

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 line 299: request handled only when |+0xC| > FLT_EPSILON; line 321 copies it to IsThrownComponent +0. Live 0.287 .. 1.313.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E8F670 writes byte 0 at +0x10; EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 line 322 copies the byte into IsThrownComponent +4. Live 3; upper bytes are garbage.

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: live garbage (0x53/0x87/0xFF...), never written by the creator

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Creator writes the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000; EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 line 323 copies it into IsThrownComponent +8. Live entity handles.

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: Creator writes the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000 at +0x20. Live entity handles (different from +0x18).

open_questions: Names of all members (thrower vs. target handle; meaning of the byte and the float).
Whether +0..+0xF is one quaternion (live values are not unit length).
